lessons.title: Story Time: A Sports Day Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to discuss teamwork and effort in a sports-themed story.
success_criteria: I can say how the characters worked as a team.
I can say why effort matters.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what sports day might involve.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a sports-themed story, modelling discussion of teamwork and effort.
lessons.independent_task: Children discuss and record examples of teamwork/effort from the story.
key_questions: How did the characters work together?
Why does trying your best matter?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension of teamwork/effort theme — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a time you tried your best at something.

lessons.title: Sports Day Data: Recording and Comparing Results
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to record and compare sports results using standard units.
success_criteria: I can record a result in metres or seconds.
I can compare two results.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how sports results are recorded (times, distances, places).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model recording results using standard units (metres for distance, seconds for time) and comparing them.
lessons.independent_task: Children take part in a simple activity, recording and comparing results with a partner using standard units.
key_questions: How many metres was that throw?
Who was faster, and by how much?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note application of standard unit measuring to a real event, an end-of-year skills showcase — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Compare results of a simple game with your family using measuring or timing.

lessons.title: Designing Sports Day Bunting and Medals
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to design colourful sports day decorations using skills learned this year.
success_criteria: I can design a bunting flag or medal.
I can use a technique learned this year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap art techniques learned across Year 2 (cubism, abstract circles, printing, collage).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss applying a favourite technique from this year to design sports day decorations.
lessons.independent_task: Children design bunting flags or medals using a technique from this year.
key_questions: What technique will you use?
How does it celebrate sports day?

differentiation.greater_depth: Combine multiple techniques from the year

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe application of a full year's art techniques to a new purpose — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.plenary: Display sports day decorations ready for the event.
lessons.home_link: Make simple decorations at home using a technique you've learned.

lessons.title: Writing About My Year 2 Highlights
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write a paragraph about their favourite memory from Year 2.
success_criteria: I can write about my favourite memory.
I can use varied sentence structures.
lessons.starter_activity: Look back at photos/work from across the year if available.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a paragraph about a favourite memory using varied sentence structures (conjunctions, expanded noun phrases).
lessons.independent_task: Children write a paragraph about their favourite Year 2 memory.
resources_needed: photos/work samples from the year if available
key_questions: What was your favourite memory this year?
Can you use different sentence types?

differentiation.greater_depth: Write a detailed paragraph with varied grammar independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective writing with grammatical variety, an end-of-Year-2 writing showcase — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family your favourite memory from Year 2.

lessons.title: Sports Day Word Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve mixed word problems using a sports day context.
success_criteria: I can solve an addition problem.
I can solve a subtraction problem.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap addition and subtraction strategies across Year 2.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving word problems using a sports day context (e.g. points scored by teams).
lessons.independent_task: Children solve sports day-themed word problems within 100, showing working.
key_questions: How many points altogether?
How many more does this team need?
lessons.assessment_notes: Final word problem check for the year — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.home_link: Make up a sports day word problem for your family.

lessons.title: Year 2 Art Gallery Preparation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to select and prepare their best art pieces from the year for a gallery.
success_criteria: I can choose my best pieces.
I can say why I chose them.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all art created across Year 2 (self-portraits, minibeasts, poppies, Christmas decorations, Easter eggs, Picasso/Kandinsky pieces).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss selecting a few best pieces to represent the year's art progress.
lessons.independent_task: Children select and prepare 2-3 favourite art pieces from the year for a class gallery.
key_questions: Which pieces show your progress best?
Why did you choose these?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective selection of work showing progress across Year 2 — evidence for ART.1/ART.2.
lessons.plenary: Share selected pieces for the gallery.
lessons.home_link: Show your family the pieces you chose and why.

lessons.title: Phonics: Sports Day Word Reading Fun
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read sports-themed words fluently.
success_criteria: I can blend and read sports words.
I can read a sentence about sports day fluently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap spelling patterns practised this year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Reinforce a range of spelling patterns, applying them to sports-themed words (e.g. 'race', 'medal', 'champion').
lessons.independent_task: Children read sports-themed word and sentence cards.
key_questions: Can you read this word?
Can you read this sentence?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application, an end-of-year celebration of progress — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading sports words over the week.

lessons.title: Sports Day Maths Trail
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply a range of maths skills in a sports day themed trail.
success_criteria: I can solve a maths challenge at each station.
I can apply a skill I've learned this year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the range of maths skills learned this year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Explain the maths trail format — different sports day stations each with a maths challenge (counting, measuring, money, time, shape, times tables).
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a maths trail with sports day themed challenges covering the year's key skills.
key_questions: What skill does this challenge need?
How did you solve it?

differentiation.greater_depth: Complete all challenges independently with extensions

lessons.assessment_notes: Final fun application of the whole year's maths skills — evidence across all MATHS strands.
lessons.home_link: Make up a maths challenge for your family.

lessons.title: Sports Day Commentary
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe sports day events as they happen using rich vocabulary.
success_criteria: I can describe what is happening.
I can use exciting, varied vocabulary.
lessons.starter_activity: Listen to a short example of sports commentary.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model giving exciting commentary using rich, varied vocabulary built up across the year.
lessons.independent_task: Children take turns giving commentary on a sports day practice activity.
key_questions: What is happening right now?
Can you describe it with an exciting word?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give detailed, exciting commentary unprompted using varied vocabulary

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and vocabulary range built across Year 2 — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.home_link: Give commentary on a game you play at home.

lessons.title: Sports Day! Applying Our Maths
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to take part in sports day, applying counting, measuring and comparing skills.
success_criteria: I can take part in sports day activities.
I can count, measure or compare during the day.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sports day preparations from the week (bunting, medals, practice).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Brief recap of sports day activities and expectations (trying your best, being a good sport).
lessons.independent_task: Children take part in sports day, with adults weaving in counting/measuring/comparing opportunities.
resources_needed: bunting and medals made this week
key_questions: How many did you do?
Which was further/faster? By how much?

differentiation.support: Adapted activities and adult support as needed
differentiation.greater_depth: Take on a helper role, e.g. measuring or timing for others

lessons.assessment_notes: Celebratory final session — informal observation of participation, effort and applied maths skills.
lessons.plenary: Medal presentation and whole-class celebration to mark the end of Key Stage 1.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family all about sports day and your favourite part of Year 2!

lessons.title: Celebrating Our Key Stage 1 Achievements
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to share and celebrate an achievement from across Key Stage 1.
success_criteria: I can share something I'm proud of from Year 1 or 2.
I can celebrate a friend's achievement too.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole of Key Stage 1's learning journey (Year 1 and Year 2).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss what makes an achievement worth celebrating, modelling sharing one from across the two years.
lessons.independent_task: Children share an achievement from Key Stage 1 with the class, and celebrate others' achievements.
resources_needed: Work samples from across Key Stage 1 if available
key_questions: What are you most proud of from Year 1 and 2?
What is a friend's achievement you'd like to celebrate?

differentiation.greater_depth: Share multiple achievements with detailed reflection

lessons.assessment_notes: Final spoken language and reflective assessment for the whole of Key Stage 1 — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class celebration of two years of achievements, marking the end of Key Stage 1.
lessons.home_link: Share your Key Stage 1 achievements with your family.

lessons.title: Key Stage 1 Maths Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on their maths progress across the whole of Key Stage 1.
success_criteria: I can say what I could do in Year 1.
I can say what I can do now.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key maths milestones from Year 1 and Year 2.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on the huge maths progress made across Key Stage 1 (from counting to 20 to multiplying and dividing within 100).
lessons.independent_task: Children reflect on and record their maths progress across Key Stage 1.
resources_needed: Maths work samples from across the two years if available
key_questions: What could you do in Year 1?
What can you do now?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give detailed reflection on specific areas of progress

lessons.assessment_notes: Final Key Stage 1 maths reflection, marking the transition to Key Stage 2 — evidence for MATHS.N1 and across all strands.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class celebration of two wonderful years of maths learning — congratulations on finishing Key Stage 1!
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your Key Stage 1 achievements with your family and get ready for an exciting Year 3!

lessons.title: Key Stage 1 Art Gallery Exhibition
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to display and reflect on their art progress across the whole of Key Stage 1.
success_criteria: I can display my favourite pieces.
I can talk about how my art has improved since Year 1.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap art created across both Year 1 and Year 2.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss reflecting on progress made in art skills and techniques across the whole of Key Stage 1.
lessons.independent_task: Children display their selected pieces in a class exhibition, reflecting on their progress since Year 1.
resources_needed: Selected art pieces from the two years
key_questions: How has your art improved since Year 1?
What are you most proud of?

differentiation.greater_depth: Give detailed reflection on progress and technique across two years

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective language and progress recognition across the whole of Key Stage 1's art learning — evidence for ART.1/ART.2.
lessons.plenary: Whole-school/class Key Stage 1 art gallery celebration — a joyful close to two years of learning.
lessons.home_link: Invite your family to see (or hear about) your Key Stage 1 art gallery and celebrate finishing Key Stage 1!
